key.name: tray-icon
key.summary: Display an icon in the system tray
key.description: If enabled, an icon will be placed into the system tray to, for example, display the current Tailscale connection status.

key.name: show-offline-peers
key.summary: Show offline peers in the sidebar
key.description: If enabled, peers that are offline and are not exit nodes are listed in the sidebar. Exit nodes stay visible even when offline.

key.name: polling-interval
key.summary: Interval at which to poll the Tailscale daemon
key.description: An interval, in seconds, at which to poll the Tailscale daemon for status changes and other things.

key.name: taildrop-auto-save
key.description: If enabled and a destination directory is set, incoming Taildrop files are saved to that directory while Trayscale is running.

key.name: taildrop-auto-save-dir
key.description: Filesystem path of the directory where incoming Taildrop files are written when auto-save is enabled. Empty means no destination is configured.

key.name: auto-switch-exit-node
key.description: If enabled, Trayscale manages a specific Mullvad exit node, checks real internet connectivity through it, and switches when that path appears unhealthy. This is separate from Tailscale Automatic mode.

key.name: auto-switch-threshold
key.summary: Seconds of confirmed failure before switching
key.description: How long active exit-path probes must continuously fail before Trayscale attempts to switch to another Mullvad exit node.

key.name: auto-switch-probe-interval
key.description: How often Trayscale performs a lightweight TCP health check through the selected Mullvad exit node. DNS is also checked when Tailscale DNS is enabled.
